descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S24 「真手机摄像头：拍一份打印出来的合成记录」 Real phone camera: photograph a printed synthetic note

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T4 A photographed prior note is read by Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is used word for word with only the request format adapted, and the read text ke …（TFA-94425 AC 1；TFA-94425 AC 2；TFA-94425 AC 3；TFA-94425 AC 4）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Debug builds bundled for the local stack on real iOS and Android phones (Android: adb reverse tcp:4510/4511 as in android-lane.ts; iOS: an Xcode debug build whose Convex URL is the Mac's LAN address for 4510/4511), signed in with an e2e-fresh-* account from freshAccount() on the local stack. …

When Previous Notes → Photograph → camera (capture=environment) → shoot the page flat, then tilted with glare

Then The camera opens, and the read text lands in the box for review with every value exactly as printed (or [illegible])

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：The tester compares the read text with the printout value by value; any changed value is a Fail of T4. Two more observations are recorded but not judged here, because they belong to TFA-92591 and are gated: nothing is saved until Save & Extract (U1), and a failed read shows a clear message with nothing lost (U15)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
